defects.reproduction: Generate a debug LaTeX report from a project under a Japanese Windows path and run pdflatex.
defects.expected: A compilable report with a readable safe path representation.
defects.actual: pdfLaTeX rejected an unconfigured CJK path character.
defects.workaround: Use the JSON report for the exact path.
defects.proposed_fix: Keep exact Unicode in JSON and render an ASCII file name or explicit safe placeholder in LaTeX.

defects.reproduction: Render an implementation formula containing a project-qualified FreeVariable name.
defects.expected: The human report displays the local symbol while JSON retains the canonical name.
defects.actual: The LaTeX formula displays the fully qualified symbol compacted in math italics.
defects.workaround: Read the exact canonical symbol and source mapping in semantic-debug-report.json.
defects.proposed_fix: Apply the Phase 11 local-symbol display projection in the standalone debug renderer.

defects.reproduction: Render the one-page probability LaTeX report.
defects.expected: Status fields use consistent paragraph spacing.
defects.actual: A few adjacent status fields share a visual line.
defects.workaround: The fields remain legible and are structurally separate in JSON.
defects.proposed_fix: Centralize certificate paragraph and status-row rendering during stabilization.

defects.reproduction: Compare same-op IR nodes whose axis or reduction_order metadata differs outside a Reduce wrapper.
defects.expected: AXIS_MISMATCH or REDUCTION_ORDER_MISMATCH.
defects.actual: The metadata difference was accepted as equivalent.
defects.workaround: None; this is a release blocker.
defects.proposed_fix: Compare axis, named dimension, and reduction-order metadata on every semantic node carrying it.

defects.reproduction: Run the assurance suite and inspect true_acceptance and unresolved for corpus-only cases.
defects.expected: Only executed checks contribute to acceptance metrics; registered cases remain unresolved.
defects.actual: Registered metamorphic cases were counted as true acceptances and adversarial registrations were omitted from unresolved.
defects.workaround: None; consumers could overestimate assurance coverage.
defects.proposed_fix: Separate registered obligations from executed evidence and count them as unresolved.

defects.reproduction: Classify unresolved causes for a result containing raw ast.Call or ast.Constant evidence.
defects.expected: Diagnostics are serialized without aborting the project entry.
defects.actual: json.dumps raised TypeError and 15 entries were marked frontend failures.
defects.workaround: Inspect the raw ProjectAuditResult directly.
defects.proposed_fix: Use the same fail-closed string serialization fallback as other audit artifacts.

defects.reproduction: Analyze a class or nested method containing a recognized save/to_netcdf sink.
defects.expected: The unresolvable method owner remains an explicit fail-closed sink boundary.
defects.actual: The method name was treated as a top-level definition and raised KeyError during output analysis.
defects.workaround: Exclude entries containing class method sinks.
defects.proposed_fix: Only bind sink owners present in top-level resolver definitions and diagnose other owners explicitly.

defects.reproduction: Exclude generated mutations outside the audited slice while using evaluated result count as the only loop limit.
defects.expected: Mutation generation has a deterministic bounded attempt budget.
defects.actual: Outside-slice cases did not advance the stop condition, causing an unbounded corpus walk and 1.7 GB process growth.
defects.workaround: Interrupt the validation process manually.
defects.proposed_fix: Track generated attempts separately from evaluated cases and collect per-attempt analysis state.

defects.reproduction: Reparse a copied source whose line numbers change while the selected output semantics remain unchanged.
defects.expected: Provenance-only differences are excluded from semantic-changing mutation cases.
defects.actual: Raw IR inequality classified 26 provenance-only cases as critical false acceptances.
defects.workaround: Manually compare IR after removing source spans and canonical line identifiers.
defects.proposed_fix: Use the independent provenance-insensitive semantic signature before comparator evaluation.

defects.reproduction: Compute library reference-only coverage from a typed LibraryContract provenance object.
defects.expected: Formal, reference-only, and unresolved calls are counted after contract serialization.
defects.actual: The summary treated ReferenceProvenance as a dict and raised AttributeError.
defects.workaround: Read contract.to_dict() before inspecting provenance.
defects.proposed_fix: Use the public serialized contract representation and checkpoint long-running validation stages.

defects.reproduction: Analyze an accumulator updated only inside an if statement in a finite range loop.
defects.expected: The predicate is retained in a FoldLeft body with the additive identity on the untaken path.
defects.actual: The loop-carried accumulator was lowered as a Map, losing the state-fold meaning.
defects.workaround: Write the condition as an explicit np.where term inside the accumulator update.
defects.proposed_fix: Recognize branch-specific accumulator updates and retain the condition in the FoldLeft term.

defects.reproduction: Compare if c then a else b with if c then b else a while both sides expose the same input names.
defects.expected: Same-named visible inputs remain fixed and the branch swap is rejected.
defects.actual: Unconstrained alpha renaming mapped a to b and b to a, accepting the semantic mutation.
defects.workaround: Inspect symbol mappings and reject permutations of same-named inputs manually.
defects.proposed_fix: Pre-bind the intersection of visible free-symbol names to identity before alpha matching.

defects.reproduction: Remove a Windows ephemeral checkout containing read-only Git pack index files.
defects.expected: Each checkout is removed in its context cleanup and its analysis result is retained.
defects.actual: shutil.rmtree raised PermissionError, overwrote successful analysis with failure, and left cleanup to the parent temporary directory.
defects.workaround: Rely on deletion of the enclosing temporary run directory.
defects.proposed_fix: Clear read-only attributes only inside the verified mkdtemp checkout root before recursive cleanup.

defects.reproduction: Compare (a + b) + c with a + (b + c) after fixing same-named symbols to identity.
defects.expected: Real-number mathematical equivalence remains established while IEEE-754 reassociation stays non-equivalent.
defects.actual: The identity-binding safety fix exposed the comparator's lack of associative flattening and broke the existing IEEE-754 regression.
defects.workaround: Use an identical association tree on both sides.
defects.proposed_fix: Flatten Add/Multiply trees and perform bijection-preserving commutative matching.

defects.reproduction: Mutate numpy.nanmean(values, axis=0) to axis=1 in an private research-scale corpus research script and compare the extracted Statistics IR.
defects.expected: The public axis parameter is classified as AXIS_MISMATCH.
defects.actual: The generic semantic debugger did not traverse the keywords map, so an unequal parameter map produced no localized difference and mutation validation reported FALSE_ACCEPTANCE.
defects.workaround: Inspect retained keyword maps before accepting reference-contract equivalence.
defects.proposed_fix: Compare semantics-bearing keyword parameters and classify axis, dimension, dtype, and method changes explicitly.

defects.reproduction: Compare torch.sum(x, dim=0, keepdim=False) with torch.sum(x, dim=1, keepdim=True) after reference-contract lowering.
defects.expected: The extracted Reduction IR preserves dim as axes and keepdim as keepdims so the mutations are rejected.
defects.actual: The generic NumPy keyword projection read only axis and keepdims, dropping both PyTorch parameters.
defects.workaround: None; parameter loss affects the equivalence boundary.
defects.proposed_fix: Use package-specific dim/keepdim aliases and lock the extracted shape constraint in regression.

defects.reproduction: Synthesize a FiniteSum and independently audit the generated range(int(lower), int(upper)) loop.
defects.expected: The frontend recovers the finite loop bounds as exact Mathematical IR.
defects.actual: The redundant int calls were preserved as OpaqueNumericCall bounds and prevented exact round-trip comparison.
defects.workaround: Generate range(lower, upper) when the bounds are already integral by contract.
defects.proposed_fix: Remove redundant int wrappers from canonical Python reduction lowering and retain integral-bound obligations separately.

defects.reproduction: Run project-wide FormulaTracer.analyze() without an explicit target on a generated accumulator loop.
defects.expected: The returned accumulator is selected and represented as FoldLeft.
defects.actual: Default project output selection can expose the accumulator initializer while audit_python(function='compute') correctly extracts FoldLeft.
defects.workaround: The generation verifier invokes the same Python frontend through audit_python with the generated function selected explicitly.
defects.proposed_fix: Unify default project return-target selection with function-scoped Python audit output selection.

defects.reproduction: Plan generation for an Integral expression whose structure unifies with the scipy.integrate.quad provider pattern and inspect provider eligibility.
defects.expected: The quadrature implementation is represented by APPROXIMATION_OF with an error-bound obligation and cannot be selected as exact.
defects.actual: The previous typed-unification path could label the provider RIGOROUS_EXACT_MATCH when its contract obligations were declared satisfied.
defects.workaround: None; provider selection is a verification boundary.
defects.proposed_fix: Separate exact e-class equality from non-exact relation edges and exclude NON_EXACT_RELATION_CANDIDATE from selection.

defects.reproduction: Audit an expression containing a radix-preserving Constant and run constant-fold and Lean finite-sum-bound comparison.
defects.expected: Numeral presentation provenance does not alter the mathematical integer value.
defects.actual: Whole-dictionary equality treated numeral_representation metadata as semantic and broke valid constant recognition.
defects.workaround: Use decimal literals without presentation metadata.
defects.proposed_fix: Compare Constant op/value semantically and retain radix only as ignored presentation provenance.

defects.reproduction: Enable the reverse direction of Add(x, 0) -> x where the reverse source is a bare PatternVariable and saturate a structured expression.
defects.expected: Only well-formed Mathematical IR expressions are added and saturation terminates within its budget.
defects.actual: The wildcard reverse direction matched scalar metadata fields, generated malformed IR, and exhausted the e-node budget.
defects.workaround: Use only the reducing direction for identity rules.
defects.proposed_fix: Disable expansive wildcard reverse directions and reject them during registry validation.

defects.reproduction: Request the algebraic structures implied by NumericDomain.NATURAL and test whether RING is satisfied.
defects.expected: Natural numbers form a commutative semiring and do not imply additive inverses or Ring laws.
defects.actual: NATURAL was mapped to COMMUTATIVE_RING, authorizing ring-only rewrites.
defects.workaround: Manually reject ring-only rules for natural-number expressions.
defects.proposed_fix: Add Semiring and CommutativeSemiring structures and map Natural exclusively to the latter hierarchy.

defects.reproduction: Analyze a returned loop accumulator lowered from AugAssign after exact source-span propagation was enabled.
defects.expected: Synthetic AST nodes without end offsets remain analyzable and inherit only valid source origins.
defects.actual: Source-span construction attempted arithmetic on a None end offset and converted the output into UnresolvedOutput.
defects.workaround: None; provenance collection is part of the analysis path.
defects.proposed_fix: Treat absent synthetic AST offsets as unknown and fall back to available start offsets without inventing a span.

defects.reproduction: Re-run synthesis, constant propagation, Python CFG, and Python/Rust canonical-IR regressions with inline source/operator/argument metadata.
defects.expected: Location-only provenance is retained for debugging but excluded from mathematical equivalence.
defects.actual: Several legacy canonicalization boundaries compared provenance dictionaries as mathematical structure, producing seven false divergences.
defects.workaround: None; valid equivalences were rejected.
defects.proposed_fix: Exclude all location-only keys at semantic comparison boundaries and recover literal origins from enclosing argument spans.

defects.reproduction: Store a verified incremental result, alter only the serialized cached value while preserving the key, then perform an exact-key lookup.
defects.expected: Any key or payload integrity uncertainty rejects reuse and triggers reanalysis.
defects.actual: The initial cache draft authenticated the key but not the value payload, so a modified result could retain CACHE_HIT.
defects.workaround: Disable incremental cache reuse.
defects.proposed_fix: Store and verify a canonical cached-value digest in addition to the complete versioned cache key.

defects.reproduction: Run generated code with the default network_disabled policy on the reference Windows backend.
defects.expected: Network access is OS-denied or execution fails closed.
defects.actual: The initial implementation scrubbed proxy variables and disclosed the limitation but still executed without enforceable network denial.
defects.workaround: Do not execute generated code on a backend lacking network isolation.
defects.proposed_fix: Block execution by default whenever requested network denial cannot be OS-enforced; require an explicit opt-in for weaker runtime evidence.

defects.reproduction: Compare the tracked LICENSE file with the complete canonical Apache License 2.0 text named by pyproject.toml and CITATION.cff.
defects.expected: Release artifacts contain the complete approved project license text and consistent metadata.
defects.actual: The pre-fix LICENSE contained an abbreviated notice while metadata declared Apache-2.0.
defects.workaround: None required after the complete license text was installed.
defects.proposed_fix: Install the complete canonical Apache-2.0 text, align all metadata, and re-audit built release artifacts.

defects.reproduction: Run pip wheel with build isolation disabled in the measured RC environment.
defects.expected: Declared build requirements provide the wheel build command needed for artifact inspection.
defects.actual: Metadata generation failed with invalid command bdist_wheel because wheel was not declared as a build dependency.
defects.workaround: Install wheel manually before building.
defects.proposed_fix: Declare wheel>=0.42 in build-system.requires and rebuild the artifact.

defects.reproduction: Configure the Visual Studio or NMake CMake generator from the repository path containing Japanese characters on the measured Windows host.
defects.expected: CMake completes compiler detection and generates the C/C++ conformance build.
defects.actual: CMake exits with 0xC0000409 after successful compiler identification; direct MSVC compilation succeeds.
defects.workaround: Use the versioned direct-MSVC conformance runner, which compiles, links, and executes both tests.
defects.proposed_fix: Revalidate with a newer CMake and an ASCII checkout, then restore CMake as an additional non-authoritative path when stable.

defects.reproduction: Build a wheel containing formulatracer_c_api.dll without a platform-tag override.
defects.expected: The DLL-bearing artifact is tagged for Windows x86-64 while remaining independent of the CPython ABI.
defects.actual: The initial artifact was incorrectly tagged py3-none-any, permitting installation on incompatible platforms.
defects.workaround: Do not distribute the discarded any-platform build.
defects.proposed_fix: Mark the wheel non-pure and emit the py3-none-win_amd64 tag; install and execute it in a fresh environment.

defects.reproduction: Parse A^T, A^{-1}, x_i, T_1, |x|, <x,y>, f', overbar, raw star, cdot, and times without declarations or a notation mode.
defects.expected: The parser resolves an operator from grammar and declarations or returns AMBIGUOUS_NOTATION.
defects.actual: The legacy Python surface parser globally replaced caret, underscore, dot, and times notation, permitting an unintended power/index/multiplication interpretation.
defects.workaround: None required for the covered adversarial forms; unimplemented notation remains fail-closed.
defects.proposed_fix: Reject overloaded notation without role evidence, parse explicit finite-sum binders structurally, and lock adversarial regression tests in both engines.

defects.reproduction: Configure the Clang frontend in the isolated Ubuntu 24.04 validation environment using the official LLVM 18 CMake packages.
defects.expected: CMake discovers LLVM and Clang 18 and builds the frontend.
defects.actual: The pre-fix configuration used a Windows-oriented version lookup and did not accept the Linux package layout.
defects.workaround: None required after the portable discovery logic was validated.
defects.proposed_fix: Use portable LLVM/Clang package discovery, require major version 18 explicitly, and execute a real extraction fixture on Linux.

defects.reproduction: Run the full private research-scale corpus validation under observe_python_semantic_runtime and inspect <PRIVATE_AUDIT_OUTPUT>/runtime-semantic-paths.json.
defects.expected: Production mathematical decisions execute in formulatracer-core; direct Python semantic-reference calls are zero.
defects.actual: The staged checkpoint measured remaining Python ownership. After Waves 1-4 and final cutover, the full private research-scale corpus run records 25,354 Rust-native decisions, zero direct Python semantic calls, and zero fallback; external-21 records 63 Rust-native decisions with the same zero Python counts.
defects.workaround: None required after final native ownership certification.
defects.proposed_fix: Completed all dependency-ordered owner migrations, focused differentials, production reachability, and full runtime remeasurement with both Python reference and fallback counts at zero.

defects.reproduction: Compare full private research-scale corpus validation with and without the sys.setprofile ownership observer.
defects.expected: Production ownership evidence has acceptable overhead for repeated migration gates.
defects.actual: The measured internal validation wall time increased from approximately 610 seconds to 1,296 seconds, excluding some profiler overhead visible in external wall time.
defects.workaround: Run the observer only at migration gates and retain aggregate-only events.
defects.proposed_fix: Replace profile-hook discovery with generated explicit boundary instrumentation as each Kernel route migrates.

defects.reproduction: Profile the external-21 or private research-scale corpus workflow and compare all Python frame calls with cross-module semantic decision entries.
defects.expected: Runtime ownership counts one cross-owner semantic decision and separates production, validation oracle, presentation, serialization, construction, helpers, and recursion.
defects.actual: The V1 observer counted every nested Python frame, inflating the private research-scale corpus count to 16,613,829; the initial V2 boundary observer still included to_dict, plain dataclass construction, and registry data access.
defects.workaround: None required after semantic-decision boundary filtering; historical counters remain labeled as non-comparable measurement definitions.
defects.proposed_fix: Count only cross-module semantic owner entries, retain aggregate owner/operation/scope counters beyond event limits, and explicitly exclude non-semantic presentation/data operations.

defects.reproduction: Inspect the pre-fix 21-case RC-v2 summary and attempt to recover Theory IR and reconstructed Implementation/Math IR pairs for structural comparison.
defects.expected: Every case retains Theory IR, plan/provider evidence, structural quotient, reconstructed IR when produced, and explicit reasons for products that were never produced.
defects.actual: Only aggregate outcomes and semantic fingerprints were retained; later structural comparison could not distinguish unavailable reconstruction from discarded evidence.
defects.workaround: None required after versioned per-case artifacts were generated.
defects.proposed_fix: Persist schema-validated per-case artifacts with null plus explicit unavailable reasons and canonical payload hashes.

defects.reproduction: Dispatch COMPOSE_ERROR_COMPONENTS through the versioned JSON kernel with an inner error-composition operation.
defects.expected: Kernel dispatch operation and Error IR operation remain distinct and the composition request is evaluated.
defects.actual: The initial request used operation for both levels, so dispatch consumed the Error IR operation and rejected the request.
defects.workaround: None required after separating the inner error_operation field.
defects.proposed_fix: Reserve operation for kernel dispatch and use error_operation in the typed Error request schema.

defects.reproduction: Propagate a graph node constructed through ErrorComposition::default with nonzero input bounds.
defects.expected: The default graph node composes by SUM with DEPENDENCE_UNKNOWN and preserves a conservative bound.
defects.actual: Derived defaults left operation and dependency empty, which produced an unresolved or zero graph enclosure.
defects.workaround: None required after installing explicit conservative defaults.
defects.proposed_fix: Implement ErrorComposition::default explicitly as SUM plus DEPENDENCE_UNKNOWN and lock it with graph regression tests.

defects.reproduction: Ask the retained Python validation oracle to compose independent components with RSS.
defects.expected: A proven-independent RSS request is representable for differential comparison.
defects.actual: The deprecated Python oracle has no RSS composition kind and can only reject the request.
affected_verification_claims: Python reference coverage for newly formalized RSS
defects.workaround: Production uses the Rust-only typed RSS contract; independent native positive, negative, and metamorphic tests cover it.
defects.proposed_fix: Do not expand the retired Python semantic owner; retain the limitation as validation-only provenance.

defects.reproduction: Compare native DEBUG_PROJECT against the retained Python oracle for source-symbol, division-amplification, error-contribution, and shared multi-output cases.
defects.expected: Native localization preserves all directly evidenced semantic nodes and groups outputs sharing the same causal origin.
defects.actual: The first candidate omitted source-symbol and Error IR contributors, missed division amplification, and split a shared multi-output cause.
defects.workaround: None required after the generic native provenance joins were added.
defects.proposed_fix: Join recorded source-symbol, Error IR, division, and output-dependency evidence in Rust and lock parity/adversarial families.

defects.reproduction: Assemble a project provenance graph containing verification-status evidence and compare node kinds with the retained Python oracle.
defects.expected: A VERIFICATION_CLAIM node and evidenced edges are retained without fabrication.
defects.actual: The initial native graph omitted the verification-claim node.
defects.workaround: None required after native verification-claim assembly was added.
defects.proposed_fix: Create verification-claim nodes only from explicit status evidence and cover them in parity tests.

defects.reproduction: Import cpp_audit while the thin Kernel E wrappers import the public formulatracer facade at module initialization.
defects.expected: Public package import completes and native dispatch remains available.
defects.actual: The first wrapper draft introduced a circular import during package initialization.
defects.workaround: None required after native facade resolution became local to wrapper calls.
defects.proposed_fix: Keep binding imports lazy at the package-cycle boundary and retain import regression coverage.

defects.reproduction: Compare the full private research-scale corpus run before and after Kernel E cutover using the recorded performance artifacts.
defects.expected: Semantic migration should avoid unexplained material resource growth, while correctness remains the primary gate.
defects.actual: Final cutover measurement was 1077.75 s with 55,676,684 bytes peak memory, versus the earlier 995.13 s and 20,963,420-byte baseline.
defects.workaround: Use incremental audits; the semantic results, read-only boundary, and false-acceptance gates are unaffected.
defects.proposed_fix: Profile graph serialization and repeated native result projection in a later performance-focused stabilization pass without weakening provenance semantics.

defects.reproduction: Compare native F/ASSEMBLE_PROJECT_VERIFICATION with the retained Python reference on the development exact-enclosure fixture.
defects.expected: The native claim preserves the proof-chain nodes, edges, evidence, root mapping, and assumption dependencies used by AuditBundle.
defects.actual: The first native projection preserved final status but emitted an empty proof chain and placeholder root, losing evidence-bearing structure.
defects.workaround: None required after the native proof-chain and provenance joins were implemented.
defects.proposed_fix: Assemble proof nodes, proof edges, interval and Lean evidence, output-root mapping, and assumption dependencies in Rust; lock semantic differential and field-level bundle parity.

defects.reproduction: Pass (x >> 8) & 0 to bit-field extraction recognition.
defects.expected: Mask zero is not a non-empty bit field and is rejected without constructing invalid IR.
defects.actual: The retained Python implementation accepted the mask shape, computed width zero, then raised while constructing a zero-width representation.
defects.workaround: None required after both native and validation-reference recognizers reject mask zero.
defects.proposed_fix: Require mask > 0 before recognizing the contiguous low-bit mask family and lock native/reference parity.

defects.reproduction: Run the unbounded full private research-scale corpus validation after Wave 3 cutover with the default 120 mutations and 40 metamorphic cases.
defects.expected: The long read-only validation reports bounded progress and can run to completion without being mistaken for a hang.
defects.actual: The original run had no project checkpoints and was stopped at 17 minutes. The instrumented rerun completed all stages in 1850.28 seconds; the largest projects required 197, 247, and 345 seconds respectively.
defects.workaround: Use incremental private research-scale corpus audits during development; reserve the full 30-minute validation for certification.
defects.proposed_fix: Implemented project/stage progress checkpoints and a finalization manifest, then reran the full corpus without weakening semantic evidence.

defects.reproduction: Build Windows and Linux wheels from one shared checkout whose target and setuptools build caches contain both platform native libraries, then install the Linux wheel in a clean environment.
defects.expected: Each wheel contains exactly one native library for its declared platform and loads the native core.
defects.actual: The builder selected the first native artifact and newest wheel globally; stale setuptools staging allowed both a Windows DLL and Linux SO into the Linux wheel, which failed with invalid ELF header.
affected_verification_claims: native production ownership in installed distributions
defects.workaround: None required after platform-specific selection and archive-content validation.
defects.proposed_fix: Select native artifacts and wheels by current platform, remove only stale native staging copies, require exactly one expected native entry, and run clean-install smoke tests on both platforms.

defects.reproduction: Supply differently shaped theory and implementation expressions together with an unverified relation edge labelled EXACT_EQUALITY.
defects.expected: An exact relation label is treated as a claim requiring canonical or Exact E-Graph evidence and cannot establish equality by itself.
defects.actual: The first in-development implementation mapped the exact relation label directly to EXACT before checking exact evidence.
defects.workaround: None required after the exact-claim gate was fixed before release.
defects.proposed_fix: Ignore exact relation labels as evidence, require canonical identity or explicit Exact E-Graph verification, and retain non-exact edges outside exact classes.

defects.reproduction: Reconstruct an ordered IEEE-754 additive loop whose mathematical target has the shape of a finite sum.
defects.expected: The loop is an ordered floating algorithmic realization with an explicit error-bound obligation, not exact associative FiniteSum equality.
defects.actual: The first in-development loop recognizer reconstructed the same FiniteSum shape without preserving the floating execution relation.
defects.workaround: None required after floating execution metadata was made relation-bearing.
defects.proposed_fix: Emit ALGORITHMICALLY_REALIZED_BY for IEEE-754 loop reductions, preserve accumulation order, and require FLOATING_REDUCTION_ERROR_BOUND.

defects.reproduction: Run cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings with the current stable Rust toolchain.
defects.expected: The documented lint command completes without warnings.
defects.actual: The current stable Clippy reports 24 pre-existing style lints outside the physics-foundation changes; the single lint introduced in units.rs was fixed immediately.
defects.workaround: None required after all 24 findings were corrected with behavior-preserving edits and three local, reasoned trust-boundary annotations.
defects.proposed_fix: Resolve the pre-existing style lints as a bounded maintenance change without changing semantic behavior.

defects.reproduction: Generate the public API inventory from a worktree whose directory name is not .sanitized-final-work and run the tracked-tree privacy gate.
defects.expected: Public API module locations are always repository-relative and contain no workstation path.
defects.actual: A worktree-name-specific string split left absolute paths in generated API inventory records.
defects.workaround: None required after the generator was corrected and outputs were regenerated.
defects.proposed_fix: Derive module paths with Path.relative_to(repository_root) and retain a non-canonical-worktree regression test.

defects.reproduction: Run scripts/run_final_native_assurance.py in a public clean checkout without workstation-private research evidence.
defects.expected: Public release assurance never probes private research paths and records unavailable optional evidence without claiming a zero-call result.
defects.actual: The sanitized placeholder path was still opened as a required file, so every public CI environment failed before native assurance evidence was written.
defects.workaround: None required after the public/private evidence boundary was made explicit.
defects.proposed_fix: Load private runtime evidence only from an explicit maintainer environment variable; otherwise record NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_PUBLIC_RELEASE_ENVIRONMENT with null call counts.

defects.reproduction: Run the Tier 3 full semantic job on a clean Linux runner with only its declared setup steps.
defects.expected: The full Python suite has Lean 4.19 available and host-local Linux evidence expectations follow the actual runner platform.
defects.actual: Lean-dependent tests had no Lean setup, and one release-candidate assertion required linux_validation_complete=false even on Linux.
defects.workaround: None required after declaring Lean setup and making the host-local assertion platform-aware.
defects.proposed_fix: Install the pinned Lean environment in the full semantic job and assert Linux completion only on an actual Linux host.

defects.reproduction: Run lake build in a fresh Linux checkout and inspect whether .lake/build/lib/lean/CppAudit.olean is created.
defects.expected: The default and release commands compile the FormulaTracer CppAudit Lean library before Python verification tests run.
defects.actual: defaultTargets was nested under the mathlib require table, so lake build fetched dependencies and reported success without building CppAudit; a cached Windows tree concealed the empty build.
defects.workaround: None required after correcting the manifest and naming CppAudit explicitly in release jobs.
defects.proposed_fix: Declare defaultTargets at the lakefile top level, run lake build CppAudit explicitly in release validation, and retain a manifest/workflow regression test.
